notes_for_editor: Construction and early history are consistent across the register and Forest Lookouts (1935 CCC build, 45-foot Blaw-Knox, 7 x 7 cab, stone quarters). Agency conflict, not resolved: the register names the WV Division of Natural Resources as administrator and the Division of Forestry as cooperator, while the Forest Lookouts header names the Division of Forestry. The record keeps the register's DNR value, and the story reports both. Closure: no Mann-specific date found; the e-WV statewide figure is 1990. The current status is only the undated Forest Fire Lookout Association listing ('standing'); no 2024 or later report was found, and the register has no visit report. The 1950 and 1961 items are quoted by Forest Lookouts from the Raleigh Register, not read from the newspaper itself. A TopoQuest snippet gives 3,356 ft for the summit; it was not read and is not used. Access and visiting rules are unknown. No new photos. Height 13.7 m converts the 45 ft tower height.
